scalars.scalar_value: Direct experience coordinating Gender Affirming surgical care, including top surgery, bottom surgery, facial surgery, or staged multi-specialty pathways.

items.item_text: Employment is subject to a criminal background check and pre-employment physical.
Must be able to work various hours, days, shifts, on-call and locations based business needs.
Three (3) years of relevant experience.
Direct experience coordinating Gender Affirming surgical care, including top surgery, bottom surgery, facial surgery, or staged multi-specialty pathways.
Experience in surgical scheduling and referral management within plastic surgery or a related specialty.
Strong prior authorization and appeals experience, including payer specific medical necessity requirements.
Experience with OR block scheduling and utilization management in an academic medical center.
Training or experience in LGBTQ+ cultural humility, trauma informed communication, or patient advocacy.
Experience supporting patients who travel for surgery, including coordinating multi visit and multi stage care.

Under the supervision of the Service Line Leader/Practice Manager/Supervisor, the Gender Affirming Scheduler for Plastic Surgery, is responsible for coordinating clinic operations and surgical scheduling for the Gender Affirming surgical patients within Plastic Surgery, supporting Gender Affirming Providers and clinic operations at the McGrath Outpatient Pavilion. This role serves as the primary liaison for patients and partner departments such as Urology, Gynecology, and the Gender Health program team. The Scheduler manages surgical scheduling, insurance authorization, and patient surgery preparation, and guides each patient through a multistage surgical pathway with compassion, discretion, and respect for their identity and privacy.

In addition to coordinating surgical appointments and ensuring timely pre and post-operative care arrangements, the Scheduler works closely with the front office, referral team, and Gender Health program staff to confirm that referrals are complete, that required surgical readiness documentation is on file, and that referrals are distributed strategically to maximize surgical block utilization and enhance revenue. Many Gender Affirming procedures involve staged or combined surgeries across multiple surgical teams, so the Scheduler sequences cases, aligns surgeon and facility availability, and communicates timelines clearly to patients.

The Scheduler also plays a key role in revenue cycle processes by identifying opportunities to optimize billing practices, ensuring accurate documentation for reimbursement, tracking prior authorizations and appeals, and supporting financial reconciliation efforts. Additionally, the role involves troubleshooting administrative and IT issues related to clinic operations, compiling financial and compliance reports, and contributing to process improvements that enhance efficiency, patient experience, and revenue capture. Other duties as assigned.

UC San Diego Health is the only hospital system in San Diego offering the full spectrum of gender affirming services to adults ages 18 and up. Care is coordinated by a team of program managers, therapists, medical staff, and insurance representatives who specialize in adult gender affirming care, with a licensed clinical social worker helping patients navigate services.
Surgical services include:
Top surgery: mastectomy, breast augmentation, breast reduction
Bottom surgery: hysterectomy and oophorectomy, orchiectomy, phalloplasty and metoidioplasty, testicular and penile implants, vaginoplasty and vulvoplasty
Facial surgery: facial feminization or masculinization procedures
Surgical scheduling and coordination
Schedule consults, pre operative visits, surgeries, and post operative follow up for Gender Affirming procedures, including staged and combined cases that involve more than one surgical team.
Coordinate OR block time, surgeon calendars, hospital and facility resources, and equipment or implant needs, and communicate changes promptly to patients and staff.

Maintain accurate case sequencing so that required recovery intervals between stages are respected. Manage Dr. Lewis's clinic and surgical schedules and patient flow at the McGrath Outpatient Pavilion.
Patient preparation and communication
Serve as the consistent point of contact for patients throughout their surgical journey, using each patient's correct name and pronouns and protecting confidentiality at every step.
Provide pre operative instructions, travel and lodging guidance for patients from outside the area, and clear timelines for recovery and follow up.
Confirm that required clearances, labs, imaging, and readiness documentation are complete before the surgical date.
Referrals and program partnership
Partner with the front office, referral team, and Gender Health program staff to review incoming referrals for completeness and route them to the right surgeon and procedure pathway.
Distribute referrals strategically to maximize surgical block utilization.
Coordinate with Urology and Gynecology so that patients move smoothly between services.
Authorization and revenue cycle
Obtain and track prior authorizations, manage payer specific criteria, and support appeals and peer to peer reviews when needed.
Verify accurate documentation and charge capture for reimbursement, and identify billing and coding opportunities.
Support financial reconciliation and compile financial, utilization, and compliance reports.
Operations and process improvement
Troubleshoot administrative and Epic or other IT issues related to scheduling and clinic operations.
Track surgical volume, wait times, cancellations, and block utilization, and recommend process improvements.
Support front office and scheduling staff by sharing Gender Affirming surgical scheduling workflows and updates.
Excellent teamwork and collaborative abilities, with a focus on cross functional coordination between clinical, scheduling, and surgical teams.
Proficiency in Epic scheduling, referral, and surgical case request workflows.
Demonstrated commitment to respectful, affirming care for transgender, nonbinary, and gender diverse patients, including correct use of names and pronouns and careful protection of patient privacy.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with the ability to assess clinic needs, optimize scheduling, and ensure efficient referral distribution.
Working knowledge of payer criteria and documentation requirements for Gender Affirming surgery, and familiarity with the WPATH Standards of Care.
Knowledge of CPT and ICD 10 coding, facility and professional billing, and implant billing as they relate to surgical reimbursement.
